/*////////////////////////  Purchase /////////////////////////////////// */	
select type = 'PV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6),
 purledger.purinvcode))),









       Postdate = purledger.postdate,









       Due = null,









       date = purledger.postdate,









   	salesman = users.username ,









		 title = Case	 
					When purcatcode = 1 or purcatcode = 2 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8  Then (Select accounts.name
               
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        From accounts
               
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        Where accounts.acccode = purledger.suppcode)	
					Else 'Opening Purchase'	
					End,









		 gcode = 0,









		 qtyIn = Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3,








 7,








 8)  THEN
               purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
					Else  purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) + (purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits) 
               END,









		 qtyOut= 0,









		 batch = purdetail.batch,









		 purdetail.purprice,









		 purdetail.discperc,









   	 purdetail.avgprice,









		 balqty=0,









		 rate=0.00,









		 itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = :ar_icode) ,









		toutqty=0,









		expiry=purdetail.expiry,









		reference = '         ',









		price = Case When purcatcode = 3 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8 
						Then purdetail.purprice
						Else purdetail.purprice / purdetail.packunits 
						End,









		discount = purdetail.DiscPerc


from  purledger,








purdetail,








	users	  

where purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and	
	 	purdetail.icode = :ar_icode	and 	
	 	purledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate 	and
		purledger.Posted = 'Y' and 
		purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode

UNION

       Postdate = prledger.date,

       title = Case	 
		 				When prcatcode = 4 or prcatcode = 5 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = prledger.suppcode)

		 prdetail.prprice,

		 itemname='                                        '				,

		reference = '          ',









		price = prdetail.prprice,









		discount = prdetail.DiscPerc

 prdetail,
